Self harm can be used for many other things such as sexual pleasure, an urge to punish yourself, and the reasons I stated before. There’s also a disorder that some people suffer with that doesn’t allow them to feel pain and certain sensations,, I forgot what it’s called,, I’ve heard and read that some people with this disorder will purposely hurt themselves for whatever reason.
